Waiting areas and an update
The desk is glad to help this afternoon
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with companion animals should check in early, keep documents ready, and follow the staff guidance at the desk to avoid delays. We are reviewing waiting areas and boarding support so that pets and their travelers can move through the process calmly and safely.

<<FACT F065>> Please keep carriers secure, use suitable bedding, and make sure doors and fastenings are in good order before arrival. Staff will note any service changes in the desk ledger and will explain the next steps in plain words.

For small dog travel, <<FACT F074>> Bring only the items needed for comfort and control, and keep the pet close while moving through the terminal. If you need help with crate checks or boarding guidance, the welcome team is ready to assist and will direct you to the proper place.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before boarding.
